what_it_does: BLASTP is an essential genomics tool that searches DNA sequences for similarity to a database. GPUs should accelerate BLASTP but have historically underperformed optimized CPU implementations. BLAZE combines fine-grained and coarse-grained parallelism (running different tasks at different scales), custom code paths for different sequence lengths, and GPU-specific optimization strategies to finally make GPU-accelerated BLASTP faster than the fastest CPU implementations.
